summary: 0x201d6-0x21270 is CM550's J1939 multiplexing input layer: it turns the j1939_received_* bytes that the six receive handlers store into engine inputs. Two tasks drive it: the 10 ms task 0x21070 runs the 17 two-bit switch inputs of j1939_input_signal_descriptor_table, the fan request, the retarder selection and five output-bit copies; the 50 ms task 0x21146 runs the accelerator inputs (low idle switch, idle switch pair, pedal position, remote accelerator) and the wet tank pressure. Each processor clears its input's bits in three one-dword bitmaps (0x800aa0 not-available data, 0x800aa4 message timeout, 0x800aa8 pedal input message timeout), tests its calibration enable bit and the module priority 0x808158 (e2m 12FE MXMOPZ) against the input's client priority, and then writes the override value (a switch's user value bit, an A/D channel's override word or a percent word) from the received byte, or the default when the message timed out or the value is not available. It is CM848's layer 0x509d98-0x50ae5c in the same address order: the nine bitmap helpers are step-for-step twins; the processors and the two tasks are counterparts, because CM848 adds the DM13 and monitor inhibit gates, a multiplex enable bit and a start delay and has its own fault bits, while CM550 has two processors CM848 lacks (remote accelerator, wet tank pressure) and files every fault under bit 0 of 0x806000.

functions.role: Clears bit N (the J1939 input number) of the one-dword bitmap at 0x800aa0.
functions.discriminator: It is the clear helper for 0x800aa0, the bitmap that 0x202d8 sets where a received value is 'not available' (a byte of 0xfb-0xfd or 0xff, a two-bit switch state of 3); its siblings 0x20210 and 0x2024a clear 0x800aa8 and 0x800aa4.
functions.plate_comment: (J1939 input number): clears bit N of j1939_input_data_error_bitmap (dword N >> 5 - mask 1 << (N & 31)), the bit that marks input N as delivering a not-available value. Each input processor calls it for its own input before it evaluates the input again. The same instructions and the same place in the layer in CM550 (0x201d6) and CM848 (0x509d98): one shared name.
functions.evidence: CM550 0x201da move.w (12,a7),d2; 0x201de-0x201e8 low byte sign-extended then lsr.l #5 = dword index; 0x201ea-0x201f8 mask = not (1 << (byte and 0x1f)); 0x20200 movea.l #0x800aa0,a0; 0x20206 and.l d2,(0,a0,d0.l*4). CM848 0x509d98: srawi r4,r3,5 / slw of 1 by r3 mod 32 / not / lwz - and - stw at 0x3fbd5a + 4 x index (lis r12,64; addi -17062). Step match: same index, same mask, same 32-bit and-store, base = the first of three consecutive dword bitmaps (CM550 0x800aa0 / a4 / a8 = CM848 0x3fbd5a / 5e / 62: +0 / +4 / +8 in both). Position: first of nine helpers that stand in the same order in both firmwares (clear +0 +8 +4, any +0 +8 +4, set +0 +8 +4: 0x201d6-0x20348 and 0x509d98-0x509f90). Call sites 0x2039a 0x20434 0x204d0 0x207a4 0x208c6 0x20e2e 0x20fc6 (retarder, fan, low idle switch, remote accelerator, switch entry, idle switch pair, wet tank); CM848's callers are the five of these processors that exist there. abs_refs: 0x800aa0 is referenced only at 0x20202 0x2028a 0x20302.

functions.role: Sets bit N (the J1939 input number) of the one-dword bitmap at 0x800aa0.
functions.discriminator: It is not a generic bit setter: the base 0x800aa0 is fixed in the code. Its eight call sites are exactly the 'not available' branches of the processors - byte values 0xfb-0xfd / 0xff and two-bit switch state 3 - never a timeout.
functions.plate_comment: (J1939 input number): sets bit N of j1939_input_data_error_bitmap: input N delivered a not-available value (a byte of 0xfb-0xfd or 0xff, or a two-bit switch state of 3) while its message is still arriving. The input tasks report any set bit as the data error fault. The same instructions and the same place in the layer in CM550 (0x202d8) and CM848 (0x509f18): one shared name.
functions.evidence: CM550 0x202d8-0x2030e: index and mask as 0x201d6 without the not; 0x20300 movea.l #0x800aa0,a0; 0x20306 or.l d2,(0,a0,d0.l*4). functions.role: Converts the received J1939 engine retarder selection byte (input 5) into the retarder selection percent word, or loads the default and flags the input when its message timed out or the value is not available.
functions.discriminator: Input number 5: timer word 0x80423e, source byte 0x80d719 (j1939_received_engine_retarder_selection), scale x 4 / 10, output word 0x80d728 with the default 0x80815a and the client priority byte 0x80d726; its enable is bit 4 of algorithm_enable_flags_33_cal (0x803cd6), which no sibling reads.
functions.plate_comment: J1939 input 5, the engine retarder selection (EBC1 byte 5, j1939_received_engine_retarder_selection): while algorithm_enable_flags_33_cal bit 4 is set and j1939_input_source_priority is not below j1939_engine_retarder_selection_source_priority it writes j1939_engine_retarder_selection_percent = raw x 4 / 10 for a raw value up to 250. A timed out message (j1939_input_signal_timeouts[5] = 0), the error value 0xfe and a not-available value load j1939_engine_retarder_selection_default_percent instead; the timeout sets the input's timeout bit and a not-available value its data error bit. Called from the 10 ms J1939 input task (0x21070). The counterpart of cm848_processJ1939EngineRetarderSelection (0x509fcc), which adds the DM13 and monitor inhibit gates and takes its enable from word 13 bit 0.
functions.evidence: 0x20396 / 0x2039e clear data error and timeout bit 5 (bsr 0x201d6, 0x2024a); 0x203a8 move.w (0x803cd6).l,d0 / andi.w #0x10 / beq exit; 0x203b6-0x203c6 word 0x808158 against byte 0x80d726, blt exit; 0x203c8 tst.w (0x80423e).l; zero: 0x203d0 set timeout bit 5, 0x203da move.w (a3),(a2) = 0x80815a -> 0x80d728; 0x203e2 cmpi.b #0xfa,(a4) (a4 = 0x80d719): at most 250 -> lsl.l #2, divu.l #10, move.w d0,(a2); 0x203fc cmpi.b #0xfe -> default only; otherwise 0x2040a default and 0x2040c set data error bit 5. Called once: jsr at 0x21094. CM848 0x509fcc: the same steps and constants (li r3,5; cmpwi 250; slwi 2 / divwu 10; cmpwi 254; priority 0x5c340 against byte 0x40aac0; output 0x40aac2, default 0x5c342) plus lhz 0x40adda (DM13 flag) at 0x50a018 and lhz 0x40aaca (monitor inhibit) at 0x50a038 and 0x50a0a8, and the enable is lhz 0x3fd5b6 bit 0 (0x509fec). CM550's family has no operand for either flag (every absolute operand of 0x201d6-0x21270 was listed).

functions.role: Writes the received J1939 accelerator pedal low idle switch state (input 6) into the override value of logical switch 7, the idle switch, or the switch's default state when the value is error or not available.
functions.discriminator: Input number 6: it tests the timer word 0x804240 itself and writes only switch 7 (bit 7 of 0x80bcd8, priority byte 0x80bd4a + 7), setting the timeout and pedal input timeout bits 6 on a lost message. Its sibling 0x20e14 reads the same byte but writes both switches 7 and 8, tests no timer and needs the sampled throttle override bit as well.
functions.plate_comment: J1939 input 6, the accelerator pedal low idle switch (EEC2 byte 1 bits 1-2, j1939_received_accelerator_pedal_1_low_idle_switch), into logical switch 7, the idle switch: while the switch's override enable (algorithm_enable_flags_13_cal bit 7) is set and j1939_input_source_priority is not below switch_input_source_priority[7] it claims the switch and - at priority 0 - writes the switch's override value (switch_1_to_8_override_values bit 7): on for 1, off for 0, the default state bit (j1939_switch_input_default_state_bits bit 7) for 2 (error) and 3 (not available, which also sets the input's data error bit). A timed out message (j1939_input_signal_timeouts[6] = 0) sets the input's timeout and pedal input timeout bits and leaves the switch as it is. Called from the 50 ms J1939 accelerator input task (0x21146). The counterpart of cm848_processJ1939AcceleratorLowIdleSwitch (0x50a1b4), which adds the monitor inhibit gate and writes the switch through its priority helpers.
functions.evidence: 0x204cc-0x204e0 clear data error, timeout and pedal input timeout bit 6 (bsr 0x201d6, 0x2024a, 0x20210); 0x204e6 move.w (0x803cae).l,d0 / andi.w #0x80 / beq exit; 0x204f4-0x20500 word (a5) = 0x808158 against byte (7,a2) = 0x80bd51, blt exit; 0x20512 move.b (1,a5),(7,a2) (the priority word's low byte into the switch priority); 0x20518 tst.w (0x804240).l; zero: 0x20520 set timeout bit 6, 0x20528 set pedal input timeout bit 6, return; 0x20538 cmpi.b #3,(a4) (a4 = 0x80d71a): set data error bit 6 (0x2053e), then if (7,a2) is 0: move.l (0x807d6a).l,d0 / btst #7 -> ori.b #0x80,(a3) or andi.b #0x7f,(a3) (a3 = 0x80bcd8); 0x20572 cmpi.b #2: the same default write; else 0x205ac tst.b (a4) -> ori.b #0x80 / andi.b #0x7f. Called once: jsr at 0x2114e. CM848 0x50a1b4: li r3,6 three clears in the same order; enable lbz 0x3fdbce bit 7; priority 0x5c340 against 0x40c058 + 7; timer 0x3feab0; values 3 / 2 / else; default lbz 0x6456e bit 7; writes through 0x4ea40 / 0x4ea84 with (7, 0); plus the monitor inhibit flag 0x40aaca at 0x50a22c and 0x50a260.

functions.role: Sets the idle and not idle switch override values and throttle_above_idle_flag from local inputs: the raw sampled throttle A/D reading, or the debounced raw not idle switch.
functions.discriminator: The only function of the family that reads no J1939 byte and no timer: its sources are the QADC result register of the sampled throttle (0xfff2b0 + 2 x index, compared with 360 counts) and the raw not idle switch bit (0x80bced bit 0 XOR 0x800aaf bit 0) with the debounce timer 0x800aac and the previous state 0x800aae. Its one caller is the pedal position processor's timeout branch (0x20d0c). It reads an MC68336 register directly, hence the mc68k_ prefix.
functions.plate_comment: The local fallback for the idle validation switches while the J1939 pedal message is lost (its one caller is cm550_processJ1939AcceleratorPedalPosition on a timeout): it sets the override values of logical switch 7 (idle) and 8 (not idle) and throttle_above_idle_flag. With algorithm_enable_flags_25_cal bit 3 set (limp home on the analog throttle) it stores the sampled throttle's QADC result register in idle_check_accelerator_pedal_raw and takes more than 360 counts as off idle. Otherwise it debounces the raw not idle switch (switch_9_to_16_raw_values bit 0 XOR switch_9_to_16_polarity_bits_snapshot bit 0) with accelerator_idle_switch_debounce_timer (100, minus 50 per unchanged pass, applied at 0) and accelerator_idle_switch_previous_state. The counterpart of cm848_updateIdleSwitchesFromLocalInputs (0x50a2cc), which also has a debounce armed flag and writes the switches through its priority helpers.
functions.evidence: 0x205e0 move.w (0x803cc6).l,d0 / andi.w #8. Set: 0x205ee index = word 0x806be2 (sampled_throttle_sensor_config + 16, the QADC result register index), 0x205f8 move.w (0xfff2b0 + 2 x index),(0x80d72c).l, 0x20604 cmpi.w #0x168,(0x80d72c).l; at most 360: andi.b #0xfe,(1,a1) (0x80bcd9 bit 0 off), ori.b #0x80,(a4) (0x80bcd8 bit 7 on), clr.w (a3) (0x80aa86); above: the opposite and move.w #1,(a3). Clear: 0x20636 d2 = byte 0x80bced, 0x2063c-0x20652 (d2 XOR byte 0x800aaf) and 1; 0x20658 cmp.b (0x800aae).l,d2; different: 0x20698 store d2 in 0x800aae and move.w #0x64,(a2) (a2 = 0x800aac); same: tst.w (a2), subi.w #0x32,(a2), bgt exit, clr.w (a2), then the same two switch writes and the flag from d2. No priority test anywhere. One call site: 0x20d0c. 0xfff2b0 is referenced by only one other function, mc68k_processAnalogSensorChannels (0xb856). 0x80bced is the raw image byte of inputs 8-15: mc68k_sampleAndDebounceDiscreteInputs stores it at 0x1502c before the polarity XOR at 0x15070. CM848 0x50a2cc: enable lhz 0x3fd5ce bit 3; analog branch cmpwi 360 with the result stored in 0x40aac6; switch branch reads cm848_readSwitchHardwareInput(8), previous state 0x3fbd68, timer 0x3fbd66 100 / minus 50; differences: the armed flag 0x3fbd69, a forced A/D reading option (0x3fdb78 bit 13) and writes through 0x4ea40 / 0x4ea84 at priority 0.

functions.role: (logical input, output number): copies one bit of the output image into the override value bit of one logical input when that input's override is enabled and the priority allows.
functions.discriminator: The only function of the family that reads the output image (0x80bcf6 + output / 8): its source is an output command bit, not a received J1939 byte, and it touches no timer and no fault bitmap. Both of its numbers are arguments; the 10 ms task calls it five times with constants.
functions.plate_comment: (logical input, output number): while the input's override enable bit is set (bit input + 208 of the algorithm enable words, that is words 13-17) and j1939_input_source_priority is not below switch_input_source_priority[output number] it claims the input and - at priority 0 - copies the output's bit of the output image (0x80bcf6 + output / 8) into the input's override value bit (0x80bcd8 + input / 8).
